prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, I'd rather not say my full name on the recording, that's fine, I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was at a signalized intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I was making a left turn across the oncoming lanes when the other car hit my driver's side.

Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?

A: I had a green arrow for the left turn. At least, I believe it was green. I started forward once the arrow turned on.

Q: Was there any traffic in the oncoming lanes when you started?

A: There was one vehicle a fair distance away. I judged it was far enough to make the turn, but I may have misjudged its speed.

Q: How fast do you estimate the other vehicle was traveling?

A: I honestly can't say. It seemed faster than the posted limit, but I wasn't really paying attention to its speed at that moment.

Q: What injuries did you experience after the collision?

A: My right shoulder hit the door frame and the seatbelt pulled hard across my chest. The shoulder is very sore and I can't lift my arm above my head without pain. I went to the emergency room that same day and they took X-rays and gave me a sling.

Q: Have you seen any other medical providers since then?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up with an orthopedic clinic and I'm starting physical therapy next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I didn't intend for any of this to happen, and I'm willing to cooperate fully with whatever you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
